Guest Seating Experience
The Guest Seating Experience is an interactive digital seating solution designed to provide
guests with a convenient and seamless way to locate their assigned table.
Depending on the package selected, the service may include:
    Digital guest seating directory
    Guest name search functionality
    Assigned table lookup
    32” Premium LED Signage
    Customized event imagery and/or branding
    Digital display setup and installation
    On-site setup and removal
The exact services provided will be based on the package selected and reflected on the
Client’s invoice.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement

Guest Seating Information & Client Portal
The Client is responsible for providing HMP with an accurate and finalized guest seating list
through the designated Client Portal. The guest list should include the following information,
as applicable:
    Guest first and last name
    Table number or name
    Seating assignment
    Any relevant grouping or seating information

The Client shall use the Client Portal to upload the guest list and make any necessary
additions, corrections, or updates to guest names, table assignments, and other seating
information. The Client is responsible for ensuring that all information submitted through the
portal is accurate and up to date.

HMP will use the information provided by the Client through the Client Portal to create and
configure the digital guest directory.

The Client may make real-time changes and updates to the guest list through the Client
Portal. If troubleshooting or assistance is needed with the portal or guest list, the Client may
contact the HMP Events Concierge Team for support.


Payment Method
HMP Luxury Event Services currently accepts payment through the payment method(s)
identified on the Client’s invoice.

Any applicable payment processing fees, returned payment fees, or other charges will be the
responsibility of the Client.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement
Cancellation & Retainer
The non-refundable retainer is used to reserve the Client’s event date and secure HMP Luxury
Event Services’ availability.

If the Client cancels the booking twenty (20) days or more prior to the scheduled event
date, [Insert Event Date], any unpaid balance may be waived. However, any retainer or other
payments previously made will remain non-refundable, unless otherwise required by
applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

If the Client cancels after the stated cancellation deadline, the Client will not be eligible for a
refund and may only request to reschedule the services for a different event date, subject to
HMP’s availability and approval.

Rescheduling after the cancellation deadline is not guaranteed, and the new event date must
be confirmed in writing by HMP. Additional fees may apply depending on the new date,
services requested, or other applicable circumstances.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement

Rescheduling
Requests to reschedule an event must be submitted to HMP Luxury Event Services in writing
at least twenty (20) days prior to the Client’s scheduled event date, [Insert Date].

Rescheduling requests are subject to HMP’s availability and the availability of the requested
services, equipment, or rental items. A rescheduled event date must occur within one (1)
year of the original scheduled event date.

A request to reschedule does not automatically transfer or guarantee the Client’s booking to
the requested date. The new event date must be confirmed in writing by HMP before the
rescheduling is considered approved.

Requests submitted less than twenty (20) days before the scheduled event date may be
considered on a case-by-case basis and are not guaranteed to be accommodated.

HMP will make reasonable efforts to identify an available date; however, rescheduling is
subject to HMP’s availability and is not guaranteed. If HMP is unable to provide an available
date within one (1) year of the original event date, the Client will not be entitled to a refund
of the retainer or any other payments previously made, unless otherwise required by
applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

Any additional fees resulting from the rescheduled date, changes in services, equipment,
rental items, or other applicable circumstances will be the Client’s responsibility.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement

Rush Booking, Cancellation & Rescheduling
If the Client books services fourteen (14) days or less, the booking will be considered a Rush
Booking and may be subject to an Expedited Fee, determined based on the event date, service
requirements, scope of work, customization needs, equipment requirements, and preparation
time available.

For Rush Bookings, full payment is due at the time of booking in order to secure the event date
and services.

If the Client cancels a Rush Booking after payment has been received, no refund will be issued.
The Client may only request to reschedule the services, subject to HMP Luxury Event Services’
availability.

Rescheduling is not guaranteed and is subject to the availability of HMP, the requested services,
equipment, and rental items. Any rescheduled event date must occur within one (1) year of the
original scheduled event date.

If HMP is unable to identify an available date within one (1) year of the original event date, the
Client will not be entitled to a refund of any payments previously made, unless otherwise required
by applicable law or expressly agreed to by HMP in writing.

Any additional fees resulting from the rescheduled date, changes in services, equipment, rental
items, or other event requirements will be the Client’s responsibility.




Equpiment & Property
All HMP equipment, including but not limited to LED displays, stands, kiosks, tablets, computers,
cables, accessories, and related equipment, remains the property of HMP unless otherwise stated
in writing.

Client agrees not to move, modify, tamper with, or allow unauthorized individuals to operate HMP
equipment.

Client may be responsible for repair or replacement costs resulting from damage caused by the
Client, guests, venue personnel, vendors, or other unauthorized persons.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement
Guest Use Of Equipment
Guests may interact with the Guest Seating Experience and HMP Luxury Event Services’
equipment only as intended and instructed by HMP.

The Client is responsible for any damage, misuse, tampering, or loss of HMP equipment caused by
the Client, the Client’s guests, attendees, vendors, or other individuals at the event.

If HMP equipment is damaged during the event, the Client will be responsible for the applicable
repair or replacement costs. Any damage fee will be determined by HMP based on the extent and
severity of the damage, including the cost of repair, replacement parts, labor, or replacement of
the equipment, as applicable.

HMP will notify the Client of any applicable damage charges following the event.

Technology & Service Interruption
HMP will make reasonable efforts to ensure that the Guest Seating Experience is operational and
available during the agreed service period.
However, HMP cannot guarantee uninterrupted operation in circumstances involving:
    Power failure
    Internet or network interruption
    Venue restrictions
    Equipment malfunction
    Severe weather
    Third-party technology failures
    Acts beyond HMP’s reasonable control

HMP will make reasonable efforts to troubleshoot or provide an appropriate alternative when
possible.

Force Majeure
HMP shall not be considered in breach of this Agreement for delays or failure to perform caused
by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to severe weather,
natural disasters, government restrictions, venue closures, transportation disruptions, power
outages, labor disruptions, equipment failures, or other unforeseen circumstances.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement
Client Responsibility
Client agrees to:
    Provide accurate guest and seating information.
    Meet all submission deadlines.
    Provide required event materials and branding in a timely manner.
    Provide venue access for setup and removal.
    Inform HMP of venue rules and restrictions.
    Ensure guests and vendors do not intentionally damage HMP equipment.
    Make all required payments according to the agreed schedule.

HMP Responsibility
HMP agrees to:
  Provide the services outlined in the Client’s selected package.
  Prepare the Guest Seating Experience using the information provided by the Client.
  Complete setup and testing within the agreed service window, when venue access is available.
  Make reasonable efforts to ensure the system is operational during the contracted service
  period.
  Provide professional assistance consistent with the services purchased.

Public Release & Marketing Use
Unless the Client opts out in writing, the Client grants HMP Luxury Event Services permission to
photograph, record, and/or capture images or video of HMP’s rental items, signage, setup,
displays, and services provided at the Client’s event for use in HMP’s public portfolio, website,
social media, advertising, promotional materials, marketing campaigns, publications, and other
public-facing business purposes.

HMP may publicly display and distribute such content without additional compensation to the
Client.

HMP will make reasonable efforts to avoid publicly identifying or displaying private or sensitive
Client information unless the Client has provided such information for promotional use or
separately approved its use.

Client Public Release Authorization:

☐ I authorize HMP Luxury Event Services to use photographs, videos, and other media captured at
my event for public marketing, promotional, and portfolio purposes.

☐ I do not authorize HMP Luxury Event Services to use photographs, videos, or other media from
my event for public marketing or promotional purposes.

Guest Seating Experience Services Agreement
Liability Of Limitations
HMP shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from the
use or inability to use the Guest Seating Experience.

HMP’s liability shall not exceed the amount actually paid by the Client for the specific services
giving rise to the claim, except where prohibited by applicable law.


Information Retention & Privacy
HMP Luxury Event Services will take reasonable measures to protect the Client’s and guests’
personal information and use it only as necessary to provide contracted services, coordinate
events, and maintain required business records.

Guest information collected for guest lists, check-in, and seating purposes will be retained for
thirty (30) days after the event date and then permanently deleted.

Client information and related event records will be retained for one (1) year after the event date
and then permanently deleted, except where longer retention is required by law or necessary to
resolve disputes or enforce contractual obligations.

HMP may share relevant information with third-party service providers as reasonably necessary
to deliver its services, subject to applicable privacy obligations.

Entire Agreement
This Agreement, together with the Client’s invoice, service order, and any written addenda,
constitutes the entire agreement between HMP and the Client regarding the Guest Seating
Experience Services.

Any changes to this Agreement must be made in writing and agreed upon by both parties.

Governing Law
Guest Seating Experince Services Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the state of
Maryland, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

Money Table Service Agreement
Please Note
Client will need to provide a 6ft or 8ft rectangular table with table cloth and chairs.
Money sprayed during the event is typically used to replenish the money bank. In the event that
the amount sprayed is insufficient, the client will be responsible for providing additional one-
dollar bills to ensure the bank is fully replenished.
All funds collected shall be organized into neatly banded stacks of bills, securely placed in sealed
envelopes, and stored in designated tote bags to ensure proper handling and safekeeping.

Money Table Service Agreement
Money Table Services Ending
All Money Table Services will begin the closing process fifteen (15) minutes before the
scheduled end of service {{serviceEndTime}} to allow HMP’s team sufficient time to organize and
reconcile the funds collected. Any continuation of service during this closing period is at
HMP’s sole discretion and is subject to workload and operational capacity.
Additional Time Required for Fund Organization
The Vendor shall allocate 1 hour after the conclusion of the service to package and prepare all
collected funds for the designated point of contact. In the event that the money packaging
process exceeds the allotted 1 hour, an additional fee of $65 per 1 hour (1 min -60 min)
shall be incurred until the process is complete. No funds shall be released to the designated
point of contact until all additional fees have been paid in full.
Liability
Vendor shall not be held liable for any loss or theft of funds after the service concludes or
once the final total has been transferred to the Client. Vendor’s responsibility ends upon
delivery of the counted funds and summary.
